title: Chapter 1304 - 45: The Eternal Lords

Chapter 1304 - 45: The Eternal Lords

Chapter 1304: Chapter 45: The Eternal Lords

Rumble rumble.

The Black and White Yin Yang Tai Chi Diagram spins, and the infinite Demonic Qi is being refined away. The Demonic Qi covering the entire Source World rapidly disappears.

"This?"

"Eternal Lord?"

"Has a new Eternal Lord been born?"

Master of Infinite took a deep breath.

In this timeline, the Black and White Yin Yang Taiji Diagram, which will appear in ten thousand years and enshroud the entire Source World, must be wielded by an Eternal Lord.

"Infinite, what did you see?"

The other Eternal Lords deduced from the changing expression of Master of Infinite that there was a change in the future timeline.

A new change, different from all the future timelines they had previously observed.

"Let me have a look too."

Master of Black Space also began to observe the new timeline.

Master of Wushan did the same.

The other Eternal Lords quickly started observing the new timeline as well.

As beings of time, observing timelines is instinctual.

After a short while.

All the Eternal Lords opened their eyes, their expressions intense.

"Eternal Lord, a new Eternal Lord has been born."

"Indeed, a new Eternal Lord has thoroughly cleansed the Demonic Qi and saved the Source World."

One by one, the Eternal Lords exchanged glances, their expressions filled with excitement.

Master of Infinite originally intended to follow the observed timeline to see more information about the newly born Eternal Lord.

But the commotion from the other Eternal Lords made him realize something was amiss.

"You all?"

Master of Infinite stopped observing the future timeline and looked seriously at the other twelve Eternal Lords: "Did you all see the birth of a new Eternal Lord?"

Master of Black Space and Master of Wushan, along with the other Eternal Lords, calmed their expressions at the words.

"I saw it."

"I saw it too?"

"In the future I saw, thirty thousand years from now, a Black and White Taiji Sword Light, capable of severing everything, emerged and obliterated the infinite Demonic Qi....."

As each Eternal Lord spoke.

The expressions of the other Eternal Lords began to slightly change.

Each Eternal Lord saw a different future timeline.

It was clearly different timelines.

But in all the timelines, the same event occurred.

That is, a new Eternal Lord was born.

The birth of a new Eternal Lord.

It is a good thing.

But the fact that all thirteen Eternal Lords casually observing timelines saw this future is extremely shocking.

Master of Infinite’s thoughts raced.

The other Eternal Lords also seemed grave.

Soon, the many Eternal Lords gave up on deepening their observation of a particular timeline.

Instead, they chose to observe as many timelines as possible.

Moments later.

The thirteen Eternal Lords opened their eyes again.

"Impossible."

All the Eternal Lords had incredulous expressions on their faces.

Observing timelines after billions and billions of years requires effort and focus.

But just observing timelines tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of years ahead is very easy.

In a brief moment.

The timelines observed by the thirteen Eternal Lords added up to over a hundred thousand.

Without exception.

In all future timelines.

The Source World will give birth to a new Eternal Lord.

Then cleanse all Demonic Qi and save the beings of the Source World.

...

The timelines previously observed by the Eternal Lords, millions, tens of millions, even billions of them, showed the Source World being corrupted by Demonic Qi, heading towards complete destruction.

But the timelines observed now showed the birth of a new Eternal Lord, saving the Source World from the Demonic Qi’s corruption.

Such a completely opposite future made the thirteen Eternal Lords feel incredulous.

"A new Eternal Lord is destined to be born?"

"Can an Eternal Lord indeed be destined to be born?"

"How is this possible?"

The Eternal Lords found it hard to believe.

They vaguely realized that the newly born Eternal Lord might have an origin beyond imagination.

The transformation of a time-based life form fundamentally has no foregone conclusion; ultimately, it tests the cycle of time, where innate methods are essentially useless.

Even if the Lord of Heaven Light left behind that transmission intending to break through the time cycle, cultivating it to the fifth level of perfection only enhances the probability of breaking through the time cycle.

This is already the limit.

As for the future they saw?

Even if not all futures, it is still extremely incredible.

"In any case, this newly born Eternal Lord harbors no malice toward our hometown."

The Master of Infinite pondered for a while and spoke in a deep voice.

At least among the hundred thousand future timelines they currently observed, a new Eternal Lord is destined to be born, and this Eternal Lord will certainly take action to cleanse the Demonic Qi.

"Indeed."

The other Eternal Lords nodded.

From this, it can be seen that the newly born Eternal Lord likely shares the same deep affection for the source world as they do.

The thirteen Eternal Lords present, willing to be trapped here for countless ages for the faintest hope of the future, also because of their affection for their hometown source world.

...

Source World.

Hidden World.

"Thank you, Lord Galaxy, for stepping in." Several Sect Masters spoke with excitement.

Lin Yuan’s power exceeded everyone’s expectations, able to contend with the Demon God head on without utilizing any Eternal Treasure? If not for Lin Yuan, the hidden world would have inevitably been breached under the Demon God’s continued assault.

"It’s nothing, I couldn’t possibly take those five Eternal Sources for free." Lin Yuan smiled and said.

Without those final five Eternal Sources for him to completely establish the Constant Sand Particle World.

Under the Demon God’s attack, Lin Yuan could only barely hold on, unable to resist, let alone force the Demon God to retreat voluntarily.

Barely holding on is not of great significance. With the Demon God’s relentless assault, Lin Yuan will eventually have lapses, and by then could be directly suppressed by the Demon God.

"Merely five Eternal Sources, in exchange for Lord Galaxy’s intervention... the cost is too little." An Eternal Sect Sect Master couldn’t help but say.

This is also the truth.

Five Eternal Sources, condensed at great cost by the Eternal Lords, should be more than enough to invite an Eternal Lord’s intervention.

But it depends on the timing.

Before the cosmic changes, such a trade might stand.

But after the cosmic changes, all the Eternal Lords vanished.

Eternal-level combat capability is scarce, and at this time, the willingness of an Eternal Lord to step in cannot be moved by merely five Eternal Sources.

"Lord Galaxy... have you become an Eternal Lord?" At this moment, the Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect cautiously inquired.

Upon hearing this.

The other Sect Masters immediately listened attentively.

They too were curious if Lin Yuan was now indeed an Eternal Lord.

Logically, being able to fight with the Demon God like that, who other than an Eternal Lord could do it?

But since the cosmic changes, there had been no phenomena associated with the birth of an Eternal Lord.

Moreover, before all the Eternal Lords vanished, surely no eternal-level combat forces existed in the source world apart from the Demon God.

"I am not an Eternal Lord." Lin Yuan directly stated.

This point had no need to be concealed.

With his current strength, there was no difference in being an Eternal Lord or not.

"Not an Eternal Lord?"

Receiving this answer, which had crossed their minds, the Sect Masters were profoundly shocked.

Not an Eternal Lord, yet fighting the Demon God to that extent?

"That Demon God, do you know its origin?"

Lin Yuan did not explain much about his own strength, but directly asked.

Through the battle with the Demon God, Lin Yuan gained considerable understanding of the latter.

However, the more he understood, the more surprised Lin Yuan became. He was certain that the Demon God’s former self must have been a Thirteen-tier existence.

But why would a Thirteen-tier life form appear in the source world? And why wasn’t it repelled by the source world?

"The origin of the Demon God?"

The Sect Masters looked at each other, then replied, "We do not know, only that it is one of the main sources of the magi disaster."

"The Eternal Lords didn’t tell you?" Lin Yuan asked.

With the Eternal Lords’ ability to observe timelines, they surely knew the Demon God’s true origin.

"No."

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect stated honestly.

"No?"

Lin Yuan was surprised in his heart.

There are two possibilities.

One is that the Eternal Lords themselves did not know the true origin of the Demon God.

The second is that the Eternal Lords knew the origin of the Demon God but were unwilling to speak of it.

Lin Yuan’s gaze was deep, feeling the second possibility was more likely.
